import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# ── File paths ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
input_file  = "/content/drive/MyDrive/data-flyway-eval-plots/data/compute_zfp.csv"
output_file = "/content/drive/MyDrive/data-flyway-eval-plots/exps/compute_zfp.pdf"

# ── Read CSV ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

x_col   = "Client Sleep Time"
metrics = ["CPU-to-GPU", "Compute ZFP", "GPU-to-CPU"]

x = df[x_col].values
n = len(x)

# ── Style: single blue + hatches ──────────────────────────────────────────────
bar_color = "#FFB74D"
hatches   = ["//", "", "\\\\"]   # diagonal / cross / dots
bar_width = 0.55

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

bottoms = np.zeros(n)
for metric, hatch in zip(metrics, hatches):
    values = df[metric].values
    ax.bar(
        np.arange(n),
        values,
        width=bar_width,
        bottom=bottoms,
        color=bar_color,
        hatch=hatch,
        edgecolor="black",
        linewidth=2.0,
    )
    bottoms += values

# ── Axes formatting ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(n))
x_mb = x / (2**20)  # convert to MB
ax.set_xticklabels([rf"$2^{{{int(np.log2(v))}}}$" for v in x_mb.astype(int)], fontsize=11)

ax.set_xlabel("Array Size (MB)", fontsize=18)
ax.set_ylabel("Time (ms) LOG", fontsize=18)
ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=14)

# ax.set_ylim(0, 3000)
ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.7)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)

# ── Legend: pattern swatches only (no fill colour) ───────────────────────────
legend_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(
        facecolor=bar_color,
        edgecolor="black",
        hatch=hatch,
        linewidth=2.0,
        label=metric,
    )
    for metric, hatch in zip(metrics, hatches)
]

ax.legend(
    handles=legend_handles,
    # title="Time Type",
    title_fontsize=10,
    fontsize=12,
    framealpha=0.9,
    edgecolor="black",
    loc="upper center",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.45, 1.25),
    ncol=3,
)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(output_file, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
print(f"Saved: {output_file}")
plt.close()
